title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 19.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab EE versions from 19.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 allowed an authenticated user to change the GitLab Duo Code Review consent setting of a parent group due to incorrect authorization checks. This issue has been remediated by GitLab.
